description: Ask Timera's AI Chief of Staff any question about your time, schedule, goals, or direction. The AI has access to your calendar, drift score, goals, and coaching memory. Use this for advice, analysis, or when you want the AI to look up your data and give personalized guidance.

question.description: Your question for Timera's AI coach. Examples: 'How should I spend my afternoon?', 'Am I on track this week?', 'What does my calendar say about my priorities?'

name: ask_timera
